recentItems.title: 378 dead due to leptospirosis from January to August 2026 | ANC
recentItems.description: The Department of Health said it has recorded 6,253 leptospirosis cases from January to August 29, 2026. In the 6,000 cases it logged, 378 patients have died due to the said illness.

recentItems.title: Pulis na bumangga at nambugbog sa estudyanteng rider sa Cavite humingi ng dispensa
recentItems.description:
Sa isang press briefing nitong Huwebes (Setyembre 3), humingi ng dispensa at inamin ng isang Police Senior Master Sergeant ang ginawa nitong krimen matapos ang pagbangga, panununtok, at pagbabanta sa buhay ng 20 anyos na college student nang maunahan sa U-turn slot sa isang kalsada sa Brgy. San Agustin, Trece Martires, Cavite noong Agosto 27.

recentItems.title: Lacson, Cayetano trade barbs anew over alleged corruption in Taguig | ANC
recentItems.description:
The word war continued between senators Panfilo Lacson and Alan Peter Cayetano over the alleged corruption in Taguig City.

Meanwhile, the Ombudsman has started its review of alleged corruption in Taguig infrastructure projects.

recentItems.title: Ombudsman defends move to make Bonoan state witness
recentItems.description:
Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla defended on Thursday the move to turn ex-DPWH Sec. Manuel Bonoan into a state witness in the flood control scandal.

recentItems.title: 1 on 1 with Bruno Mars: On his Filipino roots and his 'Romantic' return to PH
recentItems.description:
Global superstar and singer-songwriter Bruno Mars is coming back to the Philippines. In an exclusive sit-down with ABS-CBN News' MJ Felipe, Mars confirmed that he will bring "The Romantic Tour" to the Philippine Arena for a two-night show in May 2027.
